description: Experiment API for accessing Thunderbird's internal calendar manager. Provides CRUD operations for calendars and calendar items.

functions.name: createCalendar
functions.description: Creates a new local calendar (storage calendar).

functions.name: removeCalendar
functions.description: Removes a calendar by its ID.

parameters.name: calendarId
parameters.description: ID of the calendar to remove.

functions.name: getItems
functions.description: Returns calendar items (events/tasks) from a specific calendar.

parameters.name: rangeStartIso
parameters.description: ISO 8601 start date for the range filter (optional).

parameters.name: rangeEndIso
parameters.description: ISO 8601 end date for the range filter (optional).

functions.name: addItem
functions.description: Adds a calendar item (event/task) using iCalendar (ICS) data.

parameters.name: icsData
parameters.description: iCalendar (ICS) formatted string representing the item.

functions.name: updateItem
functions.description: Updates an existing calendar item using iCalendar (ICS) data.

parameters.name: calendarId
parameters.description: ID of the calendar containing the item.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: ID of the item to update.

parameters.name: calendarId
parameters.description: ID of the calendar containing the item.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: ID of the item to delete.

functions.name: setCalendarProperty
functions.description: Sets a custom property on a calendar.

functions.name: getCalendarProperty
functions.description: Gets a custom property from a calendar.

events.name: onItemChanged
events.description: Fired when a calendar item is added, modified, or deleted locally.
